title: 第114章 峡谷深行暗处窥伺第113章 白衣拦路密信隐情
slug: 凡人修仙开局觉醒寂灭道体
lines: 幽深峡谷顺着连绵山势向内蜿蜒延展，两侧矗立的崖壁陡峭巍峨。
裸露在外的岩体布满经年风雨冲刷形成的深浅裂痕。
一株株粗壮古木沿着岩壁缝隙扎根生长，交错缠绕的枝干在半空层层叠叠铺展开浓密树冠。
近乎遮蔽大半片天穹。
峡谷内部的光线因此变得昏暗幽暗，唯有细碎日光穿过枝叶缝隙零落坠落。
在铺满腐叶的山道投下斑驳零碎的光点。
脚下堆积着层层叠叠的枯枝与腐朽落叶，厚度足足没过鞋面。
每一步落脚都会踩碎干枯枝桠，细碎的开裂声响在静谧山谷中缓缓回荡，格外清晰。
林宸沿着山道稳步向前行走，自离开先前厮杀的谷口之后，他从没有片刻放松自身戒备。
神识从容散开，笼罩周身五十丈范围。
目光配合感知，一点点排查沿路两侧的灌木丛、凹陷岩穴与密林死角。
但凡能够隐匿身形的位置，全都被仔细扫视一遍。
先前白衣修士临别之时的告诫始终萦绕在心间。
上古遗迹早已涌入数支来历不同的修行势力，所有人皆是奔着遗迹深处潜藏的至宝与遍地灵材而来，行事阴狠不择手段。
再加上体内经脉之中还残留着灰衣人毒粉留下的阴寒余毒，没能寻到对症药材彻底拔除隐患。
前路潜藏的变数与凶险无从预估，容不得他有丝毫松懈怠慢。
肉身之中蛰伏的寂灭道体静静运转，不间断牵引周遭飘荡在空气里的天地灵气汇入体内。
精纯灵气顺着周身经脉缓缓游走，一边慢慢弥补接连两场恶战带来的灵力损耗。
一边温和消融潜藏在经脉缝隙里的阴冷毒素。
在这般潜移默化的滋养之下，赶路途中的林宸只觉得四肢原本酸胀滞涩的痛感不断减弱。
亏空的灵力也在稳步缓慢回升。
他心里清楚，此番进入上古遗迹，是自己短期之内积攒修为最好的机缘。
秘境天地灵气远比外界浓郁，山野之间遍布天然灵药，各类栖息妖兽体内还蕴存品质不俗的内丹。
恰好能一点点夯实炼气七层的根基，慢慢朝着八层、九层稳步打磨，绝不急于一时强行冲破境界桎梏。
朝着峡谷腹地深入数里之后，道路两旁开始陆续出现此前峡谷大战遗留的各类物件。
萧辰一行人此前用来设伏的捆缚绳网断裂散落在地，不少淬过剧毒的暗器大半埋进厚实腐叶之下。
裸露在外的金属表面凝着一层早已干涸发黑的血渍。
零零散散的废弃器物杂乱分布在山道左右，默默印证不久之前这里爆发过一场生死搏杀。
林宸途经这些厮杀残骸时脚步不停，视线顺势落在地面泥土之上，仔细辨认地上深浅不一的脚印纹路。
从足迹分布走向不难判断，落败之后的萧辰并没有带着麾下弟子离开这片秘境。
而是率领众人躲藏在峡谷两侧半山腰的密林深处。
这群仇敌依旧潜伏暗处，不间断盯紧自己的行进路线，耐心等候合适的出手契机。
接连两次耗费心力布置的围杀尽数落空，萧辰心底积攒的怨恨早已根深蒂固。
断然不会眼睁睁看着林宸安然抵达上古遗迹，机缘尽落旁人之手。
只是谷口一战折损人手过重，不少弟子身负外伤，众人灵力损耗严重。
短时间之内无力再度集结人手布下合围陷阱。
萧辰只能选择暂时隐忍蛰伏，一边寻僻静之地休养伤势、恢复灵力。
一边派遣身手轻便的弟子沿路尾随探查，随时汇报林宸的动向。
就在林宸暗自琢磨萧辰一伙潜藏方位之时，左侧山腰一处茂密灌木丛忽然传来一阵轻微晃动。
这般细微异动瞬间落入神识探查范畴，林宸向前迈出的脚步骤然顿住。
右手五指悄然握住腰间短剑剑柄，温润灵力顺着经脉悄然流转，随时可以拔剑应战。
他没有当即转头直视异动传来的方向，依旧保持正常赶路的体态。
content_en:
The deep canyon winds inward along the rolling hills, with steep and towering cliffs standing on both sides.
The exposed rock mass is covered with deep and shallow cracks formed by years of wind and rain erosion.
Thick ancient trees take root and grow along the gaps in the rock wall, and the intertwined branches spread out layer by layer in the mid-air to spread a dense canopy.
Almost covering most of the sky.
The light inside the canyon therefore became dim and gloomy, with only fragments of sunlight falling through the gaps between the branches and leaves.
Casting scattered spots of light on the mountain road covered with rotten leaves.
There were layers of dead branches and decayed leaves piled under the feet, so thick that they could not even cover the uppers of the shoes.
Every step you take will crush dry branches, and the sound of cracking slowly echoes in the quiet valley, which is particularly clear.
Lin Chen walked steadily forward along the mountain road. He had never relaxed his guard for a moment since he left the mouth of the valley where he had fought earlier.
The spiritual consciousness spreads out calmly, covering an area of ​​fifty feet around the body.
Using his eyes and his senses, he gradually inspected the bushes, sunken caves and blind spots in the dense forest on both sides of the road.
Any location where the figure could be hidden was carefully scanned.
The white-clothed monk's previous warning before leaving always lingered in my heart.
The ancient ruins have already seen the influx of several cultivating forces with different origins. They all come here for the treasures and spiritual materials hidden deep in the ruins, and they act ruthlessly and unscrupulously.
In addition, the cold and cold poison left by the poisonous powder of the man in gray still remained in the meridians of the body, and it was impossible to find the right medicine to completely eliminate the hidden danger.
The variables and dangers lurking on the road ahead cannot be predicted, and there is no room for any slackness on his part.
The dormant Taoist body of Annihilation in the physical body moves quietly, constantly pulling the surrounding spiritual energy floating in the air into the body.
The pure spiritual energy slowly traveled along the meridians all over the body, while slowly making up for the loss of spiritual energy caused by two consecutive fierce battles.
On the one hand, it gently dissolves the cold toxins hidden in the gaps of the meridians.
Under such subtle nourishment, Lin Chen felt that the originally sore, swollen and astringent pain in his limbs was gradually weakening during the journey.
The depleted spiritual power is also steadily and slowly recovering.
He knew in his heart that entering the ancient ruins this time was the best opportunity for him to accumulate cultivation in a short period of time.
The spiritual energy of the secret world is far richer than that of the outside world. Natural elixirs are scattered throughout the mountains and fields, and the bodies of various inhabited monsters also contain high-quality inner elixirs.
It happens to be able to consolidate the foundation of the seventh level of Qi Refining little by little, slowly and steadily polishing towards the eighth and ninth levels, and there is no rush to break through the shackles of the realm.
After going several miles deeper into the canyon, various objects left over from previous canyon battles began to appear on both sides of the road.
The rope net used by Xiao Chen and his group to set up an ambush broke and scattered on the ground. Most of the hidden weapons that had been tempered with poison were buried under the thick rotten leaves.
The exposed metal surface was covered with a layer of blood that had dried and turned black.
Scattered abandoned utensils are scattered around the mountain road, silently proving that a life-and-death fight broke out here not long ago.
Lin Chen kept walking as he passed by the remains of the fighting. His eyes fell on the soil and he carefully identified the different depths of footprints on the ground.
It is not difficult to judge from the distribution of footprints that Xiao Chen did not leave this secret realm with his disciples after his defeat.
Instead, he led everyone to hide deep in the dense forest on the mountainside on both sides of the canyon.
This group of enemies is still lurking in the dark, constantly keeping an eye on their path, patiently waiting for the right opportunity to take action.
Two successive sieges that had been painstakingly planned failed, and the resentment accumulated in Xiao Chen's heart was already deep-rooted.
He would definitely not just watch Lin Chen arrive at the ancient ruins safely, and the opportunity would fall into the hands of others.
It's just that the battle at Taniguchi resulted in too many casualties, many disciples suffered from external injuries, and everyone's spiritual energy was severely depleted.
In a short period of time, they were unable to gather manpower again to lay an encirclement trap.
Xiao Chen could only choose to endure and hibernate for the time being, while looking for a secluded place to recuperate from his injuries and restore his spiritual power.
While dispatching skilled disciples to follow and investigate along the road, they would report Lin Chen's movements at any time.
Just when Lin Chen was secretly wondering where Xiao Chen and his group were hiding, a slight shaking suddenly came from the dense bushes on the mountainside on the left.
Such subtle changes instantly fell into the scope of spiritual detection, and Lin Chen's steps forward suddenly stopped.
The five fingers of his right hand quietly grasped the hilt of the dagger at his waist, and the warm spiritual power quietly flowed along the meridians, ready to draw the sword at any time.
He did not immediately turn his head to look directly in the direction of the strange movement, and still maintained his normal posture as he was on his way.
title_en: Chapter 114: Traveling deep into the canyon and watching in the dark Chapter 113: Hidden secrets in white clothes blocking the road
